Name: Lance Dialogue Expansion Pack
Author: bigsquishy0
Description:
[center][font=Arial][size=3][b]﻿Lance Marriage – Expanded Spouse-Life for Lance (Content Patcher Pack)[/b]
[/size][/font][/center][size=2][font=Arial]This mod is a comprehensive reimagining of Lance’s marriage dialogue, designed to expand his personality, deepen his romantic presence, and make married life with him feel truly alive without altering his schedule, appearance, or event scripts. All changes are purely textual and delivered through Content Patcher, ensuring complete compatibility and ease of installation or removal.

I originally created this mod to satisfy my own gameplay desire to see Lance come to life as a rich, romantic, and responsive spouse. I wanted that man on the beach. In my own save, my farmer has a hint of mermaid ancestry, and I wanted dialogue that reflected that relationship in cute magical ways. That element is included here, but [b]completely optional[/b]—everything in this mod is [b]fully configurable[/b] through a simple config [/font]file, allowing you to tailor the experience to suit your playthrough.[font=Arial]
[/font][font=Arial]
[/font][font=Arial][color=#ffffff][b]What this mod does:[/b][/color][/font][/size][list]
[*][font=Arial][size=2][b]Adds ~600 new dialogue lines[/b] for married life:[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]morning, nightly, and rainy-day remarks[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]daily dialogue for all 28 days of each season, with unique flavor per day[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]﻿festival dialogue for every major event (Egg Festival, Flower Dance, Luau, Stardew Fair, Spirit’s Eve, Night Market), including year-specific variants so conversations evolve over time.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]﻿lines for Ginger Island and Highlands locations, with references to Lance’s research, expeditions, and reactions to your shared adventures, with the occasional flirting as you increase your hearts with him. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]﻿weather-specific and context-aware dialogue (e.g., remarks about rain, sunshine, cozy winter days, or time spent in the farmhouse)[/size][/font]
[/list][size=2][font=Arial][b]Keeps everything lore-friendly:[/b]
[list]
[*]No schedule edits, no map changes, and zero impact on vanilla files. This is pure text injected via Content Patcher.
[*]﻿[b]Keeps Lance’s voice lore-friendly and true to character.[/b]
[*]﻿Introduces an optional sea-magic subplot. Occasional lines reference your farmer's connection to the sea—beauty enhanced by salt air, strange lights around you in the surf...These hints are rare and always optional.
[/list][/font][font=Arial][b]Full Configurability: [/b][/font][font=Arial]Every element of the mod can be toggled on or off. You have fine-grained control over:
[/font][/size][list]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Daily Marriage Dialogue (enabled by default)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Festival Dialogue (can be turned off if using other festival mods)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Nighttime Variants[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Weather & Interior Chatter[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Ginger Island and Highlands-specific Lines[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Sea-Magic / Mermaid Lore References[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]NEW! Added a Gender Neutral Toggle in the config options. This should remove any gender mentions of Lance (pronouns and name), your farmer, and the wizard. [/size][/font]
[/list][size=2][font=Arial]This makes the mod flexible for many different kinds of saves and roleplays. You can use it for a magical farm, a lore-heavy run, or just a simple romance without fantasy elements. ﻿

If you're looking to enhance Lance's appearance to match the romantic tone of this mod, I [b]highly recommend[/b] [/font][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32944][font=Arial][b]OkPotentially’s [i]Homewrecker Lance[/i][/b].[/font]﻿[/url][/size]
